name: DegenLens On-Chain Gambling Intelligence
description: Verified on-chain gambling intelligence. Observes deposit and withdrawal flow for labeled crypto casino wallet clusters, attributes arbitrary addresses to operators, and screens wallets for wash-trading, velocity spikes, and sybil deposit patterns. Covers Ethereum, Base, Polygon, and Arbitrum. Every response carries a data_source field ("live" | "demo" | "unavailable") so consumers can distinguish observed chain state from degraded output.

endpoints.description: Deposit and withdrawal volume, unique depositor count, and net flow for a tracked casino over a lookback window. Both transfer directions observed. REQUEST: {"slug": "stake", "hours": 24} RESPONSE: {"slug": "stake", "deposits_usd": 2672237.51, "withdrawals_usd": 772038.14, "net_flow_usd": 1900199.37, "unique_depositors": 308, "transaction_count": 408, "confidence": 0.93, "verdict": "healthy", "reasoning": "...", "data_source": "live"}

Tracked casinos ranked by observed USD deposit volume, with market share and unique depositor counts. REQUEST: query param ?hours=168 RESPONSE: {"window_hours": 168, "count": 2, "ranking": [{"rank": 1, "slug": "stake", "deposits_usd": 24567436.62, "market_share_pct": 66.53, "unique_depositors": 3077}], "confidence": 0.9, "verdict": "leader:stake", "reasoning": "...", "data_source": "live"}

Native balance plus casino cluster attribution for an address — which operators it has interacted with over 30 days and at what confidence. REQUEST: {"address": "0x974caa...c400", "chain": "ethereum"} RESPONSE: {"address": "0x974caa...c400", "chain": "ethereum", "balance_native": 5270.82, "labeled_casino": "stake", "associations": [{"casino_slug": "stake", "interactions_30d": 6482, "cluster_confidence": 0.95}], "confidence": 0.98, "verdict": "stake", "reasoning": "...", "data_source": "live"}

Screen an address for wash-trading round-trips, transaction velocity spikes above 3 sigma, and sybil deposit patterns. Returns a 0..1 score with named evidence per matched signal. REQUEST: {"address": "0x974caa...c400", "chain": "ethereum", "hours": 24} RESPONSE: {"address": "0x974caa...c400", "verdict": "suspicious", "score": 0.45, "is_suspicious": true, "signals": ["wash-trade round-trip 0x1a2b...↔0x3c4d..."], "transfers_analyzed": 234, "confidence": 0.78, "reasoning": "...", "data_source": "live"}

Catalog of tracked casinos and their wallet cluster coverage. REQUEST: no parameters RESPONSE: {"count": 2, "casinos": [{"slug": "stake", "name": "Stake.com", "licensed_in": "Curaçao", "wallet_count": 2, "chains": ["ethereum"]}]}

address.description: EVM wallet address to trace or screen.

slug.description: Casino identifier, e.g. 'stake' or 'shuffle'. See GET /casinos.

associations.description: Casino clusters an address has interacted with in 30 days.

balance_native.description: Native token balance for a traced address.

confidence.description: Answer confidence. 0 when data is unavailable.

data_source.description: Provenance of the figures in this response.

deposits_usd.description: USD value of inbound transfers observed in the window.

reasoning.description: Human-readable explanation of how the verdict was reached.

score.description: Fraud suspicion score. Higher is more suspicious.

signals.description: Named fraud patterns matched, with evidence.

verdict.description: Short label. healthy|outflow for casino stats; normal|suspicious|critical for fraud screening; the casino slug or 'unlabeled' for wallet traces.

withdrawals_usd.description: USD value of outbound transfers observed in the window.

limitations.message: Lookback window is capped at 720 hours (30 days).
Address must be a 0x-prefixed 42-character hex string.

name: Verity On-Chain Transaction Lookup
description: Deterministic EVM transaction lookups with a compact canonical payload for ground-truth evaluation.

endpoints.description: Look up a transaction on a supported EVM chain.

limitations.message: tx_hash accepts exactly one 32-byte EVM transaction hash.

name: VulnFeed On-Chain Security Intelligence
description: Deterministic smart-contract security miner for Base. Given an EVM contract address, fetches verified source from Sourcify or Blockscout and returns a structured Slither risk report with ratings, severity counts, exploit probability, and per-finding details.

endpoints.description: Analyze a Base EVM contract address for smart-contract vulnerabilities.

limitations.message: Contract address must be a 0x-prefixed 40-hex-character address.
